access_policy.note: Do not mount evaluation.json or evaluation_assets into the Agent-visible Workspace.

similarity_rule.explanation: Three pinned native Telecom mobile-data/roaming siblings share the same user, issue, reward basis, and roaming/data troubleshooting procedure while varying phone-side and carrier-side roaming state.

adaptation_scope.included: The selected native initial state, relevant user-tool semantics, ENV_ASSERTION reward basis, and binary terminal score.
excluded: voice transport and unrelated Telecom tools
adaptation_scope.reason: The data demo serializes a completed relevant tool trajectory so any common TextModel can produce it and a package-local deterministic verifier can replay it.

runtime.note: The shared runner dispatches this package-local verifier from evaluation.json; no generated-code unsafe opt-in is required for this data-only replay adapter.
